assistant.title: Project assistant
assistant.scope_notice: This conversation stays with the project and report shown here. Changing the workbench selection does not move earlier messages or submitted actions.
assistant.close_notice: Closing this panel or browser does not cancel a sent reply or report job, and does not pause research. Reopen the same conversation to inspect its original state.
assistant.empty: No messages yet. Reading local state and opening history make no model call.
assistant.budget_help: The initial assistant allowance is zero. This form adds a finite allowance; its suggested value is 3. Each sent turn allows one assistant call. It does not add research or report calls.
assistant.report_calls: Authorize report calls for this request (optional)
assistant.report_budget_help: Assistant analysis and report authors/reviewers use separate allowances. Leave blank to use an applicable existing report allowance. Enter a finite amount only when you want to authorize report work; this does not resume research. If a report is waiting for allowance, fill this field and use Continue the original request on its recorded turn; no new assistant reply is required.
assistant.send_help: Questions and “do not modify” requests only analyze. A clear instruction to revise the selected report executes when the exact target, scope and report allowance are valid. New mathematical research needs its native authorization.
assistant.missing_session: Open a conversation in the selected project first.
assistant.read_error: The service is unavailable. Displayed messages are the last known state, not live diagnosis. Use Settings & sign-in or Guide after reconnecting.
assistant.evidence_empty: No evidence summary has been collected for this conversation.
assistant.evidence_help: The summary contains selected status and evidence references. It does not automatically bundle report bodies, the research library or credentials, and it is not uploaded anywhere.
assistant.operation_help: If a response is lost, query or recover the original operation in the recovery notice. Do not submit a replacement message or revision.
assistant.unknown_help: UNKNOWN is uncertain. Do not resend it automatically; preserve the original request and use the native evidence-based resolution.
assistant.report_not_complete: Submitting a revision is not completion. Read the actual semantic, rendering and page-review state.
assistant.open_project_required: Select a project before opening its assistant.
assistant.state.RESOURCE_WAIT: Waiting for resources or a shared slot
error.ASSISTANT_SESSION_UNKNOWN: This assistant conversation is unavailable. Open its original project or choose an available conversation.
error.ASSISTANT_BUSY: This conversation already has a reply in progress. Inspect its original request before sending another message.
error.ASSISTANT_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED: The assistant allowance is exhausted. History remains readable; new inference needs explicit finite authorization.
error.ASSISTANT_CONTEXT_INVALID: The selected assistant context is not available in this project. Reopen the exact task or report.
error.ASSISTANT_RESPONSE_INVALID: The assistant response did not satisfy its contract. The original response and failure remain recorded.
error.ASSISTANT_AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED: Explicit authorization is required for this assistant or report action.
error.ASSISTANT_TARGET_REQUIRED: Select the exact report and revision before requesting changes.
assistant.state.REPORT_RUNNING: Report authoring or review in progress
assistant.state.WAITING_RESOURCE: Waiting for resources or shared capacity
assistant.state.WAITING_REPORT_BUDGET: Waiting for a finite report allowance
assistant.failure_help: The action could not finish. Inspect its original request and evidence summary; keep the same operation for recovery.
error.REPORT_CONTENT_STALE: The exact report body changed. Open its current version and inspect your earlier requirements before requesting a new change.
error.REPORT_REVISION_STALE: The selected report revision is no longer the current editable version. Preserved earlier PDFs remain available.
error.REPORT_REVISION_SCOPE: The report section or revision scope is unclear. Name the exact section shown in the conversation, or explicitly request a full revision.
error.REPORT_REVISION_RANGE: The proposed revision changed content outside its permitted section range. It was not accepted; inspect the original result.
error.REPORT_BUDGET_REQUIRED: Report work needs its own finite allowance. Enter report calls, then continue the original request without another assistant message.
assistant.state.COMPLETED_CURRENT_REPORT: Current report completed with its required checks
assistant.state.STALE_CANDIDATE: Frozen report scope changed; inspect the preserved version
assistant.requirements_page: This view displays the requirements returned for the current history page. Read earlier pages as well; a new message does not erase their constraints.
error.ASSISTANT_SCOPE_REQUIRED: Specify the exact section or full-report scope. Earlier restrictions on other sections remain in effect.
error.ASSISTANT_SCIENTIFIC_SCOPE: This request changes scientific scope or adds research. Use the appropriate native research authorization; the assistant cannot treat it as a manuscript edit.
